phase_b.subject: Add deterministic particle core foundation
exact_particle_core_behavior: Particle state contains position, velocity, acceleration, age, and positive lifetime using a small three-component vector type.
Emitter configuration supplies deterministic initial particle state, a non-negative particles-per-second rate, and a maximum particle count.
Manual spawn copies configured state, resets age to zero, preserves stable insertion order, and refuses to exceed capacity.
Fixed-step update applies constant-acceleration kinematics to position, updates velocity, advances age, and removes particles at age greater than or equal to lifetime.
Rate emission uses a fractional accumulator and spawns each complete accumulated particle at the end of the update; capacity overflow requests are deterministically dropped.
Clear removes all particles and resets accumulated fractional emission.
Non-finite vectors, non-positive or non-finite lifetime, invalid rate, invalid timestep, and emission accumulator overflow are rejected.
The engine exposes manual spawn, update, clear, count, and read-only particle access without a graphics backend.
